verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an official Codex CLI within the ChatGPT product family. It runs from a working directory with `--cd`, supports interactive slash commands such as /memories and /fast, and takes a `--search` flag. It can inspect code, make changes, run commands and automate work from the terminal, and a Codex Security CLI is also available via npx. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Inspect code, make changes, run commands, and automate repeatable work without leaving your terminal.
Run codex from the directory you want Codex to work in, or pass --cd  (-C) to set it explicitly.
In Codex CLI, use /memories in an interactive session to control whether the current chat can use existing local memories or become an input for future memories.
In the CLI, pass `--search` to fetch live results for one run
Use `/fast on`, `/fast off`, or `/fast status` in the CLI to change or inspect the current setting.
Build with the Codex CLI, IDE extension, and cloud automation to speed up development.
